args.text:
Batch: 25 runs. 14 accepted, 11 declined, none not_reported.
Flagged (4): r02, r04, r10, r20, reason summary_outlier. Their centre REGR peak is about 84 %/h. The batch median is 42.44 %/h, so these sit at robust z of about +104.
Cleared (10): r01, r09, r11, r12, r14, r15, r16, r18, r23, r25. Every check that was run passed, and the REGR peak, peak position and growth-zone length are all within |z| < 1.3 of the batch.
What the flagged runs share: the REGR peak is about twice the batch value, while the peak position (316 µm) and growth-zone length (526–537 µm) match the other roots. Each kept 2–3 remedies over 4 steps. All three checks passed, so the checks did not catch the problem. Declined run r08 shows the same doubled peak. A uniform factor of two suggests a time-scale or frame-interval error, but I have not confirmed this from final_settings.
Note on the cleared width-free runs (r09, r11, r14, r15, r25): plane sections was not run. Its values (3.43–3.86 %/h) were above the 3.25 threshold. The width-free ratios all fall between −0.421 and −0.472.
